notes: Public Interface Contract for /api/v2/* endpoints. Companion to public_interface_contract.json (which is RC5-only). Grows as v2 endpoints stabilise; may be edited freely during shadow rollout. Once an endpoint promotes from SHADOW → ENABLED it is frozen the same way RC5 endpoints are.
isolation_guarantees: No /api/v2/* endpoint reads or writes any RC5 collection (workspace_cases, investigation_events, rc5_golden_runs, etc.).
Every /api/v2/* endpoint returns 503 when its governing flag is DISABLED.
additive_policy: Adding new /api/v2/* endpoints is FREE — no amendment required.
promotion_policy: Promoting an endpoint from SHADOW to ENABLED requires (a) full regression + versioning test suite green, (b) governance amendment note appended to GOVERNANCE.md, (c) response schema locked at this point in this file.
